import sys, tempfile, json

from mmengine import Config
reports=[]
for name,epochs,lr,milestones,ann in [('pretrain_24e',24,1e-4,[19,22],'pretrain'),('totaltext_12e',12,5e-5,[8,11],'totaltext_train')]:
    filename='projects/OCRDINO/configs/ocrdino_r50_4scale_ctc_'+name+'.py'
    cfg=Config.fromfile(filename,import_custom_modules=False)
    assert cfg.model.type=='OCRDINO'
    assert cfg.model.backbone.out_indices==(0,1,2,3)
    assert cfg.model.bbox_head.num_classes==1
    assert cfg.model.recognition_head.width_buckets==(32,64,128)
    assert cfg.train_dataloader.dataset.type=='OCRTextDataset'
    assert cfg.train_dataloader.dataset.ann_file=='annotations/'+ann+'.json'
    assert cfg.train_dataloader.dataset.data_prefix.img==''
    assert [x.type for x in cfg.train_dataloader.dataset.pipeline]==['LoadImageFromFile','OCRLoadAnnotations','Resize','OCRPackDetInputs']
    assert cfg.train_cfg.type=='EpochBasedTrainLoop' and cfg.train_cfg.max_epochs==epochs
    assert cfg.optim_wrapper.type=='AmpOptimWrapper'
    assert cfg.optim_wrapper.optimizer.type=='AdamW' and cfg.optim_wrapper.optimizer.lr==lr
    assert cfg.optim_wrapper.accumulative_counts==4
    assert cfg.optim_wrapper.paramwise_cfg.custom_keys.backbone.lr_mult==0.1
    assert cfg.param_scheduler[1].milestones==milestones and cfg.param_scheduler[1].end==epochs
    assert cfg.val_dataloader is None and cfg.val_cfg is None and cfg.val_evaluator is None
    assert cfg.test_dataloader is None and cfg.test_cfg is None and cfg.test_evaluator is None
    assert cfg.resume is False and cfg.default_scope=='mmdet'
    rendered=cfg.pretty_text
    reports.append(dict(config=filename,epochs=epochs,lr=lr,load_from=cfg.load_from,work_dir=cfg.work_dir,pretty_text_length=len(rendered)))
print(json.dumps(dict(mmengine='0.10.7',import_custom_modules=False,configs=reports)))
